8. Three fallen ink-black wolves dissolve into three small gold formation marks on a rocky path, each mark sends a warm luminous column upward.
9. A running dark ink wolf carrying a luminous gold formation seal passes between two distant golden formation circles and leaves a flowing energy trail.
